snapshot.text: Public system with National Health Insurance covering most of the population, but public health spending is low and donor funding is falling. The World Bank's 2026 health expenditure review looks at how to sustain coverage.

priorities.title: Hospitals and rural care
priorities.text: The health ministry plans to upgrade hospitals and strengthen rural health services.

priorities.title: Primary care and UHC with WHO
priorities.text: Laos and WHO reinforced their commitment to primary health care and universal health coverage.
